settings_timezone_unset: Not set: the server's own clock, {zone}.
settings_timezone_back: Back to the server's own clock, {zone}
settings_timezone_other_sub: An IANA name, such as Asia/Shanghai.
settings_language_sub: The words Decks shows, on this browser. Choosing one reloads the page.
settings_fps_sub: A meter over the canvas: frames a second, the slowest frame, and how many took over 12 ms.
settings_claude_foot: Each conversation picks its account in the model menu.
settings_claude_no_name: An account with no name yet
settings_claude_remove_title: Forget {name} and remove its credentials from this machine
settings_voice_foot: The mic in the composer, or Ctrl+M. Nothing is sent until you send it.
settings_voice_no_key: No key yet: set OPENAI_API_KEY on the server.
settings_voice_lang_sub: What the browser's recogniser listens for.
settings_conn_foot: For another Decks, the iPad app or a terminal connecting to this one. Decks Studio needs neither: its login is under Accounts.
settings_conn_code_sub: Asked for when connecting over the internet. Make one on this machine:
settings_conn_revoke_title: It will have to connect again

match.n=one: Sharing one tab. Submitting asks you first.
match.n=other: Sharing {count} tabs. Submitting asks you first.

settings_chrome_paired: Paired. Press the Decks button on a tab to share it.
settings_chrome_not_paired: Not paired. Paste the address and code below into the extension.
settings_chrome_new_code_title: Mint a fresh code; the extension has to be paired again
settings_usage_conversation_note: what it has spent, and how full its window is
settings_usage_no_reading: No reading yet. An agent reports its context after its first reply.
settings_usage_per_token: A {kind} agent bills per token and has no plan windows to run out of.
settings_usage_no_plan: This agent is not running against a claude.ai plan, so there are no windows to report.
settings_usage_no_windows: The plan reports no active windows.
settings_usage_behaviors_note: as the runtime scans this machine
settings_usage_dormant_turns: not in force · turns over in {left}
settings_usage_dormant_title: A window this plan carries and this account is not on right now
settings_alert_volume_off_sub: Off silences all three and keeps the choices.
settings_alert_not_asked: The browser has not been asked for permission yet.
settings_alert_denied: This browser blocks banners for this site; turn them on in its site settings.
settings_alert_insecure: Banners need a secure page and this one is plain http. Sounds work here; for banners, open the deck on localhost or behind TLS.
settings_alert_unsupported: This browser has no notifications. The sounds and the tab count still work.
settings_studio_sign_in_sub: This deck's canvases sync there, and you reach your agents from anywhere.
settings_studio_code_sends_back: At {host}, in the tab that opened. Press Sign it in there, or copy the code and paste it below.
settings_studio_code_copy: Open Studio at {host}, copy the code it shows, and paste it below.
settings_studio_signed_in_as: Signed in to Decks Studio as {email}
settings_studio_env_key: {host} · its key is set by DECKS_STUDIO_KEY
settings_studio_sign_out_title: Delete this harness's Studio key: the deck stops syncing, and every browser signed in to Studio loses its way here
settings_sync_offline_sub: {why} Your work is safe here, and Decks tries again by itself.
settings_sync_offline_sub_since: {why} Your work is safe here, and Decks tries again by itself. Last in step at {time}.

match.n=one: {count} canvas checked. A change here goes up within a second.
match.n=other: {count} canvases checked. A change here goes up within a second.

settings_sync_synced_sub: A change here goes up within a second.
settings_sync_connecting_sub: The first pass starts once Studio answers.
settings_sync_comparing: Comparing this deck with Studio's copy.
settings_sync_held_sub: Studio limits how much one machine sends a minute and an hour. The rest go up when the wait ends; nothing is lost.
settings_sync_left_out_sub: Over 50 MB, or refused by Studio: they stay on this machine.
settings_alert_banner_done: Show a banner when an agent finishes
settings_alert_banner_ask: Show a banner when an agent asks you something
settings_alert_banner_problem: Show a banner when something goes wrong
settings_alert_sound_done: Sound for when an agent finishes
settings_alert_sound_ask: Sound for when an agent asks you something
settings_alert_sound_problem: Sound for when something goes wrong
settings_password_this_browser: Signed in with your password on this browser
settings_password_this_browser_sub: Signing out here asks for the password again in this browser.
settings_password_not_this_browser: This browser is not signed in with the password
settings_password_not_this_browser_sub: It reaches this Decks another way, such as from this Mac itself.
settings_password_everywhere_sub: Every browser and terminal that logged in with the password has to log in again.
settings_password_everywhere_confirm_bod: Every browser and terminal that logged in with the password, this one too, has to log in again.
settings_password_change_sub: At least 10 characters. Browsers already signed in stay signed in.
settings_password_mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.
settings_password_too_short: The new password needs at least 10 characters.
settings_password_none_sub: Set one on this Mac with decks password set
